consumption_subtitle: Understand the pace. Keep some margin.
consumption_week_sub: What the last 7 days merged, and what it took.
consumption_week_dollars: {amount} API-equivalent, as the agents reported it
consumption_week_no_dollars: No dollar figure: an agent reported none this week, so the week is counted in tokens and time.
consumption_week_estimates: Estimates: {estimate} planned, {actual} taken, over {n} of {total} merged tickets.
consumption_week_estimates_none: No merged ticket had a plan estimate.
consumption_week_failed: The week's figures did not load. This page tries again by itself.
consumption_wins_sub: When several agents work the same ticket, the variant kept is the one whose tests passed with the fewest tokens, or in the shortest time when tokens are not reported.
consumption_wins_empty: No agent pick has ended yet.
consumption_not_used: No session has run on this agent yet.
consumption_quiet: No session ran in the last 7 days.
consumption_headline_hit: At the average pace of this cycle, {harness} would reach 100% on {when}, before its reset on {reset}.
consumption_headline_ok: At the average pace of this cycle, no agent reaches 100% before its reset.
consumption_headline_none: No agent has reported a quota yet.
consumption_proj_hit: {harness} reaches 100% on {when}, before the reset on {reset}.
consumption_proj_holds: {harness} holds until the reset on {reset}, at about {percent}% used.
consumption_proj_idle: {harness} has used nothing in this window.
consumption_proj_early: This window has only just opened: the pace says nothing yet for {harness}.
consumption_proj_next_hit: After the reset, the same pace would reach 100% again on {when}.
consumption_proj_next_holds: After the reset, the same pace would end the next cycle at about {percent}%.
consumption_cost_source: Reported by the agent at the end of each turn, not estimated here. A subscription does not bill this amount.
consumption_levers_label: A change applies to what starts next.
consumption_lever_model: Change the model of the next starts
consumption_lever_model_detail: New author sessions start on the chosen model. Reviewers stay on {reviewer}.
consumption_lever_lanes: Limit the sessions that run at once
consumption_lever_lanes_detail: The other steps of a ticket wait for a free place.
consumption_lever_lanes_on: At most {n} sessions at a time
consumption_lever_pause_detail: Schedules start nothing while paused. A run missed meanwhile starts once at the resume.
consumption_lever_forbidden: Only a signed-in account can change this.
consumption_lever_failed: The change did not go through. Try again.
consumption_read_failed: The service does not answer for now. This page tries again by itself.
consumption_down: Consumption is not available: the service runs no project.
consumption_footer_data: Figures come from this project's sessions. When an agent reports both windows, the seven-day one is shown.
